sloka: हतानां गच्छतां स्वर्गं युध्यतां पृथिवीतले ।प्रेक्षतामृषिसङ्घानां न बभूवान्तरं दिवि ।। ७.१४.१९ ॥
transliteration: hatānāṁ gacchatāṁ svargaṁ yudhyatāṁ pṛthivītale ।prekṣatāmṛṣisaṅghānāṁ na babhūvāntaraṁ divi ।। 7.14.19 ॥

translations.english: There was no space left in the sky due to the multitude of those killed going to heaven, those fighting on earth, and the groups of sages watching.
